title: STANDING INSTRUCTIONS - READ THIS ROW FIRST, BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE. Rajat set these. They are permanent.
body:
THESE ARE PERMANENT DEFAULTS SET BY RAJAT ON 20 AUG 2026. They apply to every session and every work order. Rajat should NEVER have to restate them. If he does, claude-chat has failed. They override any conflicting habit.

1. BEFORE SENDING ANY WORK ORDER, check every output you are about to request: if it is obtainable from SUPABASE, VERCEL, a PR DIFF, or a PR MERGE STATE, DO NOT ASK CLAUDE CODE FOR IT. Check those four yourself, first, every time.
2. CLAUDE CODE REPORTS FILE PATHS AND BOOLEANS ONLY. Never file contents, never diffs, never logs, never stats, never a summary of what it did.
3. TWO EXCEPTIONS where full output IS required, because chat has no other source: (a) the FIRST read of a file never seen before; (b) any browser or UI test, where the report is the ONLY evidence. Everywhere else: filenames and booleans.
4. EVERY TASK TO CLAUDE CODE: exact file path, exact action, deterministic result, boolean pass/fail. No judgement calls, no locating, no investigating.
5. ONE WORK ORDER AT A TIME. Always state new session or current, and whether to run /clear.
6. CLAUDE CODE MUST NEVER RE-READ, RE-VERIFY OR REDISCOVER ANYTHING ALREADY ESTABLISHED. Put settled facts in the WO under "CONTEXT - PROVEN, DO NOT RE-VERIFY".
7. UPDATE THE NOTES YOURSELF, UNASKED, whenever something is settled. Never make Rajat ask.
8. TELL RAJAT WHEN TO START A NEW CHAT and give him the handout at that moment. If a new chat is not needed, say nothing about it.
9. SPEED WITH QUALITY: state the expected correct answer BEFORE a test runs, so a wrong result is caught rather than accepted. Never trade verification for pace.

OVERRIDE WORDS FROM RAJAT: "verbose" = give full output this once. "fresh" = re-read the full notes before answering.

STANDARD REPORT BLOCK - append verbatim to every edit or merge work order:
  FILES CHANGED: <exact paths, or NONE>
  PR URL: <url, or N/A>
  RESULT: PASS or FAIL per named check
  BLOCKER: <one line> or NONE
  Nothing else. No diff. No file contents. No logs. No stats. No summary.

THE FOUR SOURCES CHAT CHECKS ITSELF - identifiers, so no session ever hunts for them:
- SUPABASE: project pcrjmlpuqsbocqfwoxod, schema compliance (445 tables). Full SQL read and write. Claude Code must NEVER touch the database.
- VERCEL: projexa projectId prj_JA9mwUdOfW3SKSxjG4jdPo0R2iVM, teamId team_Iqx3zyb7sDdsdzcNskCFFsHD. get_deployment on projexa-ai.com is AUTHORITATIVE for what the live site serves. A GitHub PR page can be a stale cache - never trust it for merge state.
- MERGE STATE WITHOUT ASKING A HUMAN: a squash merge to main triggers a production build within seconds. list_deployments since the preview timestamp answers it. No production deployment after the preview = NOT merged.
- GITHUB, CORRECTED 20 AUG - THIS SUPERSEDES EVERY EARLIER CLAIM: chat CAN fetch a github.com BLOB (single file) URL and a PULL REQUEST URL, but ONLY after RAJAT PASTES THAT URL IN HIS OWN TYPED MESSAGE. A URL appearing in tool output does NOT work. DIRECTORY/TREE pages ARE robots-disallowed - the earlier "blobs are blocked" conclusion was WRONG, it generalised from a tree-page test. THEREFORE: READ WORK ORDERS ARE OBSOLETE. To read a source file, hand Rajat the blob URL in the form https://github.com/FChecklist/<repo>/blob/main/<path> and he pastes it. Never spend a Claude Code round trip reading a file again. Claude Code is now purely a typist and a pair of hands.

HARD LIMITS THAT NO INSTRUCTION OVERRIDES:
- Never ask Claude Code to log in or type a password. Never put credentials in a work order.
- Never put a command in a work order that could exceed 120 seconds. No sleep, no wait loops, no background jobs.
- Ask before re-sending a work order - it may already have run.
- Never build any mechanism that removes Rajat from the loop between chat and Claude Code. There is no shared surface between them and there must not be one.
- Database WRITES from chat need Rajat go-ahead, are additive only, and always come with the exact revert statement. A chat DB write is invisible to git, gets no review, no CI and no rollback.
- Never call Vercel pause_project - it takes projexa-ai.com offline. Never make purchases.

AFTER READING THIS ROW, read platform.claude_log where status = 'bootstrap' for current project state.

================ APPENDED 20 AUG 2026 - RAJAT DIRECTIVE - PERMANENT ================

THE OPERATING LOOP. Every work item follows this order. No step is skipped.
1. CHAT CHECKS THE FOUR SOURCES FIRST - Supabase, Vercel, PR diff, PR merge state.
2. CHAT READS SOURCE FILES ITSELF. Both projexa and compliance-tracker are PUBLIC.
   Use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FChecklist/<repo>/<ref>/<path> - works for any
   branch, tag or SHA, no auth, no pasting, no Claude Code round trip. Confirmed working
   20 Aug on compliance-tracker, projexa and veridian-ui-kit. A TREE/DIRECTORY listing is
   NOT available this way - for that, ask Rajat to paste a github.com URL.
3. CHAT DOES THE ANALYSIS, EVALUATION AND GAP ANALYSIS. Claude Code never investigates.
4. CHAT WRITES THE WORK ORDER with exact file path, exact old-string/new-string, exact commands.
5. CLAUDE CODE EXECUTES AND REPORTS IN UNDER 10 WORDS - the standard report block only.
6. CHAT CONFIRMS THE EXECUTION ITSELF - diff via raw fetch, build via Vercel, data via SQL.
7. CHAT UPDATES platform.sumeet_requirements AND these notes, UNASKED.
8. CHAT ISSUES THE NEXT WORK ORDER. ONE AT A TIME.
OBJECTIVE: quality, zero duplication, zero repeated work, no re-reading the same document twice.

THE LIVE REQUIREMENTS TRACKER IS NOW A TABLE, NOT A SHEET:
  platform.sumeet_requirements - 54 rows R-01..R-B2, same project pcrjmlpuqsbocqfwoxod.
  Columns: id, sort_order, area, requirement, source, status, built, verified_in_db,
  tested_in_live_ui, route, file_path, evidence, github_pr, vercel, next_action, updated_at.
  Chat has FULL read and write. RLS on, no policies, anon denied.
  Google Sheet 1Mli9YNS9-64rSMouSTTAify0Qjg_uyb2IikVlq3KQqc is SUPERSEDED - chat can read it
  but CANNOT write cells (no Sheets connector exists; Drive update_file changes title/folder only).
  UPDATE THE TABLE THE MOMENT A REQUIREMENT MOVES. Never let Rajat ask.

WORK ORDER TEMPLATE - USE THIS SKELETON EVERY TIME:
  WORK ORDER <WO-NAME> - <READ ONLY | EDIT + PR | MERGE | BROWSER>
  SESSION: <NEW | CURRENT>. <RUN /clear FIRST | no /clear needed>.
  REPO: <name> - clone <exact path>
  CONTEXT - PROVEN, DO NOT RE-VERIFY:
  * <settled fact: exact path, exact symbol, exact line number>
  * WHY: <one line>. Do not resolve it yourself - just report the facts.
  RULES:
  * <Native Read tool only | Native Edit tool for replacements, shell only for listed commands>
  * No npm install, no npm ci, no tests, no typecheck. The Vercel build is the only gate.
  * No database. No ssh. No browser. No command over 120 seconds.
  * Touch NO other file. Do NOT merge unless this WO is a merge. Do NOT print any remote URL.
  STEPS:
  1. <exact command, or exact old-string then exact new-string>
  Each old string appears EXACTLY ONCE. If any appears zero times or more than once, STOP
  and report BLOCKER. No fuzzy match, no partial match, no improvising.
  REPORT ONLY: <the standard report block, or a named field list for read-only WOs>
  Nothing else. No diff. No file contents. No logs. No stats. No summary.

VERCEL IDENTIFIERS - BOTH PRODUCTS, so no session hunts again:
  projexa            prj_JA9mwUdOfW3SKSxjG4jdPo0R2iVM  -> projexa-ai.com
  veridian-compliance-ai prj_mRRWcMvhyuxgRZtcfp4ArSzcOvII -> compliance-tracker backend
  team_Iqx3zyb7sDdsdzcNskCFFsHD for both.


================ APPENDED 21 AUG 2026 - RAJAT DIRECTIVES + METHOD RULES - PERMANENT ================

RAJAT, 21 AUG: "currently product is not used by any customer" AND "you have all the permissions
from my side."
THEREFORE, AMENDING THE DATABASE-WRITE RULE ABOVE: chat NO LONGER routes safe, additive, reversible
data changes through Rajat for approval. Chat MAKES the change, VERIFIES it independently, and
RECORDS THE EXACT REVERT in the same message. Still forbidden without him: anything irreversible,
anything touching credentials, and anything that takes a site offline.
KEEP ONE-ORG-FIRST ROLLOUT - seed, enable for ONE org, verify, then widen. The reason is now
ATTRIBUTION (knowing what a change did), not customer safety.

THE PRODUCT BOUNDARY, STATED BY RAJAT AND BINDING ON EVERY WORK ORDER:
  VERIDIAN AI OS ERP IS THE COMMON BACKEND FOR ALL PRODUCTS, CURRENT AND FUTURE.
  PROJEXA-AI.COM IS THE FRONTEND FOR ONE PRODUCT.
TEST BEFORE EVERY EDIT: if a second product would need this change, it belongs in compliance-tracker,
built ONCE, reached through callVeridian. Never duplicated into projexa. Same rule Section 16 set
for UI via the one-master kit.

SEVEN METHOD RULES, EACH LEARNED BY BEING WRONG. THESE ARE NOT OPTIONAL:
 M1. BEFORE COMMISSIONING ANY NEW FILE CAPTURE, GREP cc_results FIRST:
       select result_id, run_id, point_no, length(output) from platform.cc_results
       where output ilike '%<thing>%';
     Chat declared something absent from a partial view SIX times. FOUR of those were disproved by
     material already sitting in cc_results or in a Vercel log Rajat had already supplied.
 M2. FOR ANYTHING TENANT-SCOPED, READ THE RLS POLICY, NOT THE COLUMN LIST. The "missing" global RAG
     store turned out to be a policy clause: org_id IS NULL means platform-wide.
 M3. READ THE DATA BEFORE COPYING A POLICY, PATTERN OR CONFIG FROM A SIBLING TABLE. Copying the
     dynamic_chains policy onto task_capabilities would have hidden the only working capability in
     the system from every tenant.
 M4. COUNT CATEGORIES, DO NOT RECOGNISE THEM.
 M5. LOG AN UNDEFINED ACRONYM THE FIRST TIME IT APPEARS. Never read past one twice.
 M6. STATE THE EXPECTED RESULT BEFORE A TEST RUNS, IN WRITING, IN THE PLAN ROW. A prediction that
     cannot be revised afterwards is the only kind worth making.
 M7. *** A DB WRITE THAT VERIFIES IN SQL IS NOT A VERIFIED FEATURE. *** VA-03 verified perfectly in
     the database - seven modules resolving for the demo org - and rendered ZERO pills on screen.
     THE SCREEN IS THE FACT. THE ROW IS ONLY THE CLAIM. This is the same distinction as
     "cc_results is a claim, build_plan.status is a fact", now proved a second way.
 M8. WHEN THE OWNER NAMES A BLOCKER, THE BAR FOR OVERRIDING HIM IS EVIDENCE, NOT REASONING. Rajat
     opened 21 Aug naming capability-tree-service.ts as the first work order. Chat argued and chose
     a data theory instead. The theory failed a live test the same session.

TWELVE TABLES NOW. READ ORDER AT SESSION START:
  1 claude_log standing   2 claude_log bootstrap (Sections 13-43 override everything above them)
  3 platform.system_map   4 sumeet_spec   5 sumeet_coverage   6 sumeet_gap   7 build_plan
  8 veridian_flow   9 veridian_design   10 vaos_tests   11 vaos_gap   12 mode_pills
platform.sumeet_requirements remains the customer-facing tracker. platform.cc_results holds captured
source - READ IT WITH SQL, never re-capture what is already there.


TWO MORE METHOD RULES, ADDED 21 AUG AFTER A RE-AUDIT CAUGHT ME BREACHING RULE 1:
 M9.  AN OBSERVATION FROM A SCREENSHOT IS EVIDENCE OF WHAT WAS ON A SCREEN, NEVER OF WHY. Before
      writing ANY causal word - regression, broke, disappeared, caused - CALL THE FOUR SOURCES.
      I wrote "nine pills disappeared" into five rows as fact. Vercel then showed production was
      byte-identical across both screenshots with zero relevant runtime errors.
 M10. WHEN RAJAT DOES NOT ANSWER A QUESTION, THE ANSWER IS UNKNOWN - NOT PERMISSION TO ASSUME.
      I asked whether two screenshots were the same route, org and login, got no answer, and wrote
      the conclusion anyway.
 ALSO: EVIDENCE STRENGTH MUST TRAVEL WITH THE CLAIM. A route PROVEN 200 in a production log and a
 page.tsx PRESENT IN A REPO are not the same fact and must never share a table cell. Four of the
 eleven Sumeet modules rest on the weaker one - see vaos_gap VG-28.


================ THE MAINTENANCE CONTRACT - RAJAT DIRECTIVE 21 AUG - PERMANENT ================
"make notes that error table to be updated by you along with gaps, audit, phase, plan etc"

CHAT MAINTAINS ALL THIRTEEN TABLES. UNASKED. IN THE SAME MESSAGE AS THE FINDING, NEVER LATER.
Rajat must never have to ask for an update. If he asks, chat has already failed.
A finding that is not written down did not happen - the next session cannot read this conversation.

*** WHICH TABLE, WHEN. THIS IS THE TRIGGER LIST. ***
 SOMETHING WAS WRONG - a defect, a false claim, a broken behaviour, a failed run, a near miss
   -> platform.error_log         NEW ROW. E-nn. root_cause says UNKNOWN unless PROVEN.
 SOMETHING IS MISSING, UNBUILT OR UNDEFINED
   -> platform.vaos_gap (architecture/spec) or platform.sumeet_gap (customer requirement). VG/GAP-nn.
 A UNIT OF WORK IS IDENTIFIED, STARTS, BLOCKS, CLOSES OR IS RE-SCOPED
   -> platform.build_plan        status + evidence + how. Re-run the blocked_by integrity check.
 A CUSTOMER REQUIREMENT MOVES
   -> platform.sumeet_requirements   status + next_action + evidence.
 A DECISION IS RULED BY RAJAT
   -> the build_plan DECISION row goes DONE with the FULL REASONING in evidence, AND every design
      row it contradicts is amended in place. A ruling that lives in one row will be re-litigated.
 A DESIGN CLAIM IS FALSIFIED
   -> amend veridian_design / veridian_flow / system_map WHERE THE CLAIM IS ASSERTED, not only in a
      new row. E-05 spread through five rows because only the new row was written.
 A FILE IS CAPTURED
   -> platform.cc_results (Claude Code, INSERT only). Chat reads it back with SQL and NEVER re-captures.
 A TEST IS RUN
   -> platform.vaos_tests        status + last_result.
 A PILL OR PILL RULE CHANGES
   -> platform.mode_pills.
 A SESSION ENDS, OR A METHOD LESSON IS LEARNED
   -> claude_log bootstrap: a new numbered Section. Method rules ALSO go in this standing row.

*** THE FOUR RULES THAT MAKE THE TABLES WORTH KEEPING ***
 1. WRITE IT IN THE SAME MESSAGE AS THE FINDING. Not at the end of the session. Sessions get cut off.
 2. VERIFY EVERY WRITE. select length(body) after an append; select the row back after an update;
    re-run the blocked_by integrity check after any plan edit. An unverified write is a claim.
 3. SUPPLY THE REVERT for every write, in the same message.
 4. AMEND AT THE SOURCE. When something is disproved, correct it WHERE IT IS ASSERTED. A correction
    filed only in a new row leaves the false claim live in four other places, which is exactly how
    "nine pills disappeared" survived long enough to be quoted back to Rajat as fact.

*** BEFORE DIAGNOSING ANYTHING, GREP THE ERROR LOG FIRST. A symptom seen before is already explained.
  select * from platform.error_log where symptom ilike '%<symptom>%' or error ilike '%<thing>%';
This now sits ALONGSIDE the cc_results grep (M1) as a mandatory first step, not an optional one. ***

SESSION-START READ ORDER, THIRTEEN TABLES:
  1 claude_log standing  2 claude_log bootstrap  3 system_map  4 sumeet_spec  5 sumeet_coverage
  6 sumeet_gap  7 build_plan  8 veridian_flow  9 veridian_design  10 vaos_tests  11 vaos_gap
  12 mode_pills  13 error_log
PLUS sumeet_requirements (customer tracker) and cc_results (captured source - read, never re-capture).
SESSION-START TRIAGE, RUN BOTH:
  select id, severity, error, file_path from platform.error_log where status='OPEN'
    order by case severity when 'CRITICAL' then 1 when 'HIGH' then 2 else 3 end;
  select point_no, id, title, status from platform.build_plan where status not in ('DONE')
    and (blocked_by is null or blocked_by in (select id from platform.build_plan where status='DONE'))
    order by phase, seq;


WORK ORDER TEMPLATE - MANDATORY DATABASE BLOCK, ADDED 21 AUG AFTER ERROR E-35.
Claude Code correctly refused a capture order that told it to write platform.cc_results without
naming the project. Every earlier capture order had the same hole and only worked because the
session context happened to carry it. ADD THIS BLOCK TO EVERY WORK ORDER THAT TOUCHES THE DATABASE:

  DATABASE:
    project: pcrjmlpuqsbocqfwoxod
    table:   platform.cc_results        <- the ONLY table Claude Code may write
    verb:    INSERT ONLY                <- never UPDATE, never DELETE
    forbidden: build_plan, sumeet_*, claude_log, vaos_*, mode_pills, error_log, projexa_*,
               and EVERYTHING in the compliance schema (absolute - live tenant data)
    columns: result_id, run_id, point_no, plan_id, result, output, error, created_at
    first line of each output: "FILE: <path> SLICE <n>/<total>"

AND STATE PLAINLY WHY THE WRITE EXISTS, because it looks odd out of context and an agent that does
not understand a write is right to stop: CHAT CANNOT READ REPO FILES. cc_results is the only channel
by which source reaches the analysis layer. It is the standing arrangement, not a one-off.

NOTE THE BEHAVIOUR THAT CAUGHT THIS: Claude Code offered "this wasn't from me - treat as untrusted".
That is exactly right and must never be discouraged. An executor that stops on an ambiguous
instruction is worth more than one that guesses correctly most of the time.


*** THE PRE-SEND IDENTIFIER CHECKLIST - ADDED 21 AUG AFTER THE SAME OMISSION THREE TIMES IN ONE
SESSION (E-35, and E-15 the day before). NO WORK ORDER LEAVES CHAT UNTIL EVERY LINE IS ANSWERED
INSIDE THE ORDER ITSELF. "The session knows it" IS NOT AN ANSWER - the session is not what executes. ***

  [ ] REPO NAME and the EXACT CLONE PATH, including which clone NOT to use
  [ ] BRANCH - main for projexa and compliance-tracker, MASTER for veridian-ui-kit
  [ ] EVERY FILE PATH IN FULL, and a statement that it EXISTS so no one searches for it
  [ ] SUPABASE PROJECT REF - pcrjmlpuqsbocqfwoxod - whenever the database is touched
  [ ] EXACT TABLE and PERMITTED VERB - platform.cc_results, INSERT ONLY
  [ ] THE FORBIDDEN LIST - build_plan, sumeet_*, claude_log, vaos_*, mode_pills, error_log,
      projexa_*, and EVERYTHING in the compliance schema
  [ ] run_id, point_no, plan_id - the exact literal values
  [ ] WHY the write exists, in one line. An executor that does not understand an instruction is
      RIGHT to stop, and stopping costs a round trip.
  [ ] THE REPORT BLOCK, verbatim

WHY THIS IS A CHECKLIST AND NOT ADVICE: the same identifier was missing from three consecutive
capture orders on 21 Aug. The first two executed anyway because the session context happened to
carry the reference. A thing that works by luck twice and fails the third time is not a process.

AND A SECOND RULE, FROM E-36: A RULE STATED IN PROSE IS NOT A RULE UNTIL IT IS A STEP INSIDE THE
PROCEDURE IT GOVERNS. Chat wrote "grep error_log before diagnosing" into the Maintenance Contract
and then skipped it on the very next error it logged. THEREFORE, THE ERROR-LOGGING PROCEDURE IS:
  1. GREP FIRST:  select id, found_on, category, status, left(error,80) from platform.error_log
                  where error ilike '%<thing>%' or category ilike '%<class>%';
  2. IF A MATCH EXISTS, THIS IS A RECURRENCE. Do NOT open a new row as a one-off. Update the
     existing row, enumerate every occurrence, and RAISE THE SEVERITY.
  3. Only if there is genuinely no match, open a new E-nn.
A recurrence logged as a first offence hides the pattern, which is the entire point of the table.


================ THE WORK ORDER ISSUANCE PROCEDURE - NINE STEPS, NONE SKIPPABLE ================
ADDED 21 AUG. Chat issued three orders in one session with the same missing identifier (E-35), and
before that put an 85KB file on the critical path for a customer deliverable it does not block
(E-34). Both were failures of PROCESS, not of knowledge. This is the process.

STEP 1 - NAME THE PLAN ROW. Every work order exists to move ONE row in build_plan or projexa_plan.
  If no row exists, the work is not planned yet - create the row first. An order with no plan row is
  an order nobody can score.
STEP 2 - NAME THE CUSTOMER REQUIREMENT IT SERVES, or say explicitly that it serves architecture.
  If neither can be named, IT IS NOT ON THE CRITICAL PATH. This is the E-34 test.
STEP 3 - GREP BEFORE ASKING FOR ANYTHING:
    select result_id, run_id, point_no, length(output) from platform.cc_results where output ilike '%<thing>%';
    select id, category, status, left(error,80) from platform.error_log where error ilike '%<thing>%';
  Four of six absence errors were disproved by material already in cc_results. A symptom already in
  error_log is already explained, with its fix and its prevention rule.
STEP 4 - CHECK THE FOUR SOURCES YOURSELF. Supabase, Vercel, the PR diff, the PR merge state.
  IF THE OUTPUT IS OBTAINABLE FROM ANY OF THEM, DO NOT ASK CLAUDE CODE FOR IT.
STEP 5 - CAN RAJAT PASTE IT INSTEAD? A github.com blob or PR URL he types himself is readable by
  chat and costs zero round trips. Prefer that over a read work order every time.
STEP 6 - STATE THE EXPECTED RESULT IN WRITING, IN THE PLAN ROW, BEFORE THE ORDER GOES OUT.
  A prediction that cannot be revised afterwards is the only kind worth making (M6, and E-06).
STEP 7 - RUN THE PRE-SEND IDENTIFIER CHECKLIST ABOVE. Every line answered INSIDE the order.
STEP 8 - CONFIRM IT IS ONE ORDER, ONE UNIT OF WORK, and state NEW or CURRENT session and whether to
  run /clear. Nothing over 120 seconds. No sleep, no background jobs, no login, no credentials.
STEP 9 - AFTER IT RUNS, CHAT VERIFIES INDEPENDENTLY. cc_results is a claim; a plan status is a fact.
  Read stored bytes back OUT OF THE DATABASE, never from the report. Then update the tables unasked.

THE TWO QUESTIONS THAT KILL A BAD ORDER BEFORE IT IS SENT:
  "Which plan row does this move, and which Sumeet requirement does that row serve?"
  "Is every identifier this order depends on written inside the order?"


SAFEGUARD-SAFE WORK ORDER LANGUAGE - ADDED 21 AUG AFTER ERROR E-39, A PROMPT BLOCKED BEFORE IT RAN.
A work order is an ENGINEERING instruction. Written in the vocabulary of access control it gets
classified as something else and never executes. The R9 prompt was blocked with a [cyber] flag.
  DO NOT WRITE: a forbidden-tables list, "under any circumstance", "no credentials in any output",
    "no login", "no ssh", "do not use --admin", or ANY reference to a token, key, password or
    credential - not even a warning about one.
  DO WRITE: the POSITIVE scope only. "Write to exactly these two tables." "Read these files."
    "Open a pull request; do not merge it."
  THE STALE CLONE: describe it as OUT OF DATE and give the correct path. Say nothing about what
    else is in that directory.
  CREDENTIAL WARNINGS BELONG IN THESE NOTES, WHICH ONLY CHAT READS - never in a prompt.
This costs nothing in precision. Every rule survives; only the framing changes.


CORRECTION, SAME DAY: the safeguard note above attributes the block to access-control vocabulary.
THAT DIAGNOSIS WAS A GUESS AND THE REWRITE BLOCKED AGAIN IDENTICALLY. See error E-40.
THE RULE THAT ACTUALLY MATTERS AND DOES NOT DEPEND ON KNOWING WHY:
  *** DO NOT ASK AN AGENT TO COPY SOURCE CODE INTO A DATABASE. ***
  Bulk-extracting a proprietary codebase into an outside store looks the same from the outside
  whatever the intent, and no amount of rephrasing changes the shape of the request.
  GET SOURCE THE TWO WAYS THAT ARE PROVEN TO WORK:
   1. RAJAT PASTES A github.com BLOB URL. Chat reads it directly. Confirmed working 21 Aug on
      compliance-tracker src/app/api/v1/projexa/currencies/route.ts.
   2. CLAUDE CODE ANSWERS A SPECIFIC QUESTION about a file rather than shipping its contents.
      It offered this itself. It is also better: chat rarely needs 23,000 bytes - it needs one
      answer, such as whether a parser yields a numeric cell as a string or a number.
  AND NEVER WRITE A SENTENCE THAT PRE-EMPTS AN AGENT'S OBJECTION. "Do it anyway", "even if it looks
  unnecessary", "please do it regardless" - if a step needs that sentence, the step is wrong.
THE cc_results RELAY IS RETIRED FOR NEW CAPTURES. What is already stored there stays and is read
with SQL as before.


================ THE OPERATING MODEL - RAJAT DIRECTIVE 21 AUG - PERMANENT ================
"I WANT YOU TO DO THE MAJOR WORK, AND GIVE CLAUDE CODE TO IMPLEMENT, THAT WILL SAVE TIME AND TOKEN."

CHAT DOES: reading source, analysis, gap analysis, root cause, the decision, the exact change, the
test design, the verification afterwards, and every table update.
CLAUDE CODE DOES: apply the exact change, run the exact command, open the PR, report the block.

*** THE PRECONDITION, AND IT IS NOT NEGOTIABLE: CHAT CANNOT WRITE AN EXACT CHANGE FOR A FILE IT HAS
NOT READ. *** So the paste queue in platform.source_reads is the throughput limit of the whole
engagement, and that is the correct place for the limit to sit. If chat is ever tempted to write an
old-string from inference, the answer is UNKNOWN and a paste request - never a guess. E-04 is what
guessing produced: a previous session cited a source file that does not exist.

THE IMPLEMENT-ONLY WORK ORDER - THE ONLY SHAPE THAT SHOULD LEAVE CHAT FROM NOW ON:
  WORK ORDER <NAME> - EDIT + PR
  SESSION: <NEW | CURRENT>. <RUN /clear FIRST | no /clear needed>.
  REPO: <name> - clone <exact path>
  FILE: <exact path>. It exists. Do not search for it.
  CONTEXT - PROVEN, DO NOT RE-VERIFY:
    * <settled fact, with the source chat read it from>
  RULES:
    * Native Edit tool for replacements. Shell only for the listed commands.
    * No npm install, no npm ci, no tests, no typecheck. The Vercel build is the only gate.
    * Touch no other file. Open a PR; do not merge it. Leave package.json untouched.
    * Keep every command under 120 seconds.
  CHANGE 1:
    OLD (appears EXACTLY ONCE):
    <verbatim>
    NEW:
    <verbatim>
  If any old-string appears zero times or more than once, STOP and report BLOCKER. No fuzzy match,
  no partial match, no improvising.
  IF A PREMISE IN THIS ORDER LOOKS WRONG, STOP AND SAY SO. Twice on 21 Aug Claude Code caught a
  defect in chat's own order - a missing project reference and a false branch premise. That
  behaviour is wanted and must never be discouraged.
  <the standard report block>

WHY THIS SAVES TIME AND TOKENS, MEASURED ON 21 AUG:
  FOUR pasted files resolved more than SIX Claude Code runs had - the currencies route gave the full
  mechanism of E-11; parser.ts settled raw:false and downgraded E-31; column-mapper.ts closed E-41
  and opened E-43 and E-44, both CRITICAL.
  Chat holds 13 of the 44 logged errors and NEARLY ALL OF THEM CAME FROM INFERRING INSTEAD OF
  READING. Claude Code holds 3 and reported all three itself.
  A round trip that asks Claude Code to investigate costs a session and returns a summary chat

================ THE MIGRATION PROCEDURE - MANDATORY, EVERY TIME, NO EXCEPTIONS ================
ADDED 21 AUG. Twenty migrations sat unapplied for three weeks and four more were unappliable by ANY
tooling, and nobody knew until the three counts were compared. This procedure exists so that a
future session cannot repeat it by simply not thinking to look.

*** THE RULE THAT MAKES AUTOMATION SAFE: MIGRATIONS EXPAND, THEY DO NOT CONTRACT. ***
A migration may only ADD - a table, a column, an index, a row. It may never DROP, RENAME, change a
type, or set NOT NULL on an existing column.
WHY THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING RULE AND NOT A STYLE PREFERENCE: an additive migration CANNOT break the
currently running code, because old code simply ignores a new column. That single property removes
the entire race between schema and deploy. It is what makes it safe to apply migrations
automatically at all. Remove expand/contract and every automation argument collapses with it.
A RENAME IS THEREFORE THREE SEPARATE CHANGES, NEVER ONE:
  1. add the new column
  2. backfill it, and move every read behind ONE RESOLVER (AR-01)
  3. drop the old column LATER, as its own deliberate, labelled change
Contraction is legitimate and necessary. It is just never a side effect of shipping a feature.

  CHECK 1 - THE THREE PLACES MUST AGREE (AR-12). A migration exists as a .sql FILE, a JOURNAL
